words.zh: vt. 用曲线图表示，把…绘入图表；用胶版印刷；  n. （曲线）图，图表；【化】图表，曲线图；【数】图像；【计】图表
words.example: The graph clearly shows the rise in global temperatures over the past century.

words.zh: n. 排放物；放射物；散发物；排放；发射；【化】发射，放射；【物】放射
words.example: Factories must reduce their emission of harmful gases to protect the environment.

words.zh: v. 挨饿；饿死；渴望；缺乏；需要
words.example: Without proper food, many wild animals will starve in the harsh winter.

words.zh: v. 【化】密封；  vt. 封（信封）；密封，把……封入；封锁；确定；  n. 海豹；邮戳；封条；印章
words.example: Please seal the jar after opening it to keep the cookies fresh.

words.zh: n. 生态学；生态；个体生态学；【生】生态学
words.example: The destruction of forests has a serious effect on the ecology of the region.

words.zh: v. 释放；排放（气体等）；发布，发行；免除（责任、债务等）；发泄（情感）；放开，松开，使自由移动（或飞翔、降落等）；放出，放走；释放，放出；发布，推出；【化】释放；【航】释放；  n. 上映；解除；释放；排放；发布；免除（责任、债务等）；解脱；发行，发布；发布的声明（或文件等）
words.example: Factories release harmful gases into the air every year.

words.zh: n. 【有化】甲烷，【能源】沼气；【化】甲烷
words.example: Methane produced by cattle is a powerful greenhouse gas that traps heat.

words.zh: n. 碳；复写纸；【物】碳
words.example: Carbon is an essential element found in all living organisms on Earth.

words.zh: n. 二氧化物
words.example: The factory releases sulfur dioxide, which can cause acid rain.

words.zh: phr. 二氧化碳；【物】二氧化碳
words.example: Plants absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis and release oxygen.

words.zh: adj. 可居住的；适合居住的
words.example: Scientists are searching for planets that might be habitable for human life.

words.zh: v. 维持（生命）；支撑，承受；供养；忍受；遭受，蒙受；使保持
words.example: The soil is too poor to sustain the large number of plants in this area.

words.zh: adj. 可持续的；合理利用的
words.example: We need to find sustainable ways to meet our energy needs without harming nature.

words.zh: n. 化石；  adj. 从地下发掘出来的；化石的；属于旧时代的；陈腐的
words.example: The fossil record helps scientists understand how ancient species lived and evolved.

words.zh: v. 给……加燃料；煽动；刺激；激起；加强；  n. 燃料；刺激因素；【化】燃料
words.example: Burning wood to fuel the stove releases smoke that harms the air.

words.zh: n. 化石燃料
words.example: Burning fossil fuel is a major cause of global warming.

words.zh: adj. 综合的；有充分理解力的，悟性好的；全面的，完整的；详尽的；广泛的，无所不包的；广义的；  n. 综合测验；综合学校
words.example: The school launched a comprehensive program to reduce plastic waste.

words.zh: adj. 全世界的，影响全世界的；世界各地的；  adv. 在世界各地，遍及全球地
words.example: Plastic pollution has become a worldwide problem that demands immediate action.

words.zh: v. 倾向；走向；转向；使趋向；  n. 趋势；趋向，动向；时尚；【化】趋势，倾向
words.example: The trend of rising temperatures worries scientists in many countries.

words.zh: adv. 频繁地；经常地
words.example: Students frequently discuss environmental issues in their geography class.

words.zh: v. 播放，广播；散布，传播；  n. 广播或电视节目
words.example: The local station will broadcast a documentary about ocean pollution.

words.zh: n. 保险单；政策，方针；原则，策略；【计】策略
words.example: The government introduced a new policy to limit carbon emissions.

words.zh: n. 脚印，足迹；（某物所占的）空间量；面积
words.example: Everyone should try to reduce their carbon footprint in daily life.

words.zh: v. 【化】限制；  vt. 限制；约束；限定；束缚
words.example: Some cities restrict car use to improve air quality.

words.zh: n. 限制，约束；限制规定；限制法规；【化】限制
words.example: The new restriction on single-use plastics surprised many shoppers.

words.zh: v. 抓住，逮捕；夺取，攻占；控制；抓住，把握（机会等）；捉拿，俘获
words.example: We must seize every opportunity to protect endangered species.

words.zh: n. 水池；盆地；流域；盆；低洼地
words.example: The river basin provides water for millions of people.

words.zh: n. 企鹅
words.example: The penguin waddled across the ice toward its colony.

words.zh: v. 革新；改良；（人）改正，改过自新；改造；改革；  n. 革新，变革；改良；改革；  adj. 改革的
words.example: The city plans to reform its recycling system next year.

words.zh: v. 经历；遭受，经受（变化、不快等）
words.example: The wetland will undergo restoration to bring back native birds.

words.zh: n. 工具，器具；  v. 实施，执行；使生效；贯彻；【计】实现；【法】履行
words.example: The school decided to implement a new energy-saving policy.

words.zh: adj. 和谐的，协调的；和睦的；悦耳的
words.example: A harmonious relationship between humans and nature is essential.

words.zh: v. 使减轻，使缓和（读作/ˈmɑdərˌeɪt/）；缓和；使适中；  n. 温和主义者；稳健的人；  adj. 中等的，适中的；适度的；温和的，稳健的；【化】中等的，适度的
words.example: The government hopes to moderate the effects of climate change.

words.zh: v. 提交；呈递；屈服，使...服从；建议，主张
words.example: Please submit your environmental project report by Friday.

words.zh: adj. 年度的，一年一次的；  n. 年鉴；一年生植物；年刊
words.example: The annual tree-planting activity attracts many enthusiastic volunteers.

words.zh: adj. 热带的；来自热带的；炎热的
words.example: Tropical rainforests are home to countless unique species.

words.zh: n. 混乱，纷乱；混沌；杂乱；紊乱；【电】混沌
words.example: The oil spill caused chaos along the entire coastline.

words.zh: phr. 代表…...，为了…...；为帮助
words.example: I thank everyone on behalf of our class for recycling.

words.zh: adj. 核能的；原子能的；细胞核的；原子核的
words.example: Many countries are debating whether to use nuclear energy.

words.zh: n. 有灵异能力的人， 敏感的人；  adj. 敏感的；过敏的；灵敏的；善解人意的；易受伤害的；感光的；玻璃心；【化】敏感的
words.example: Some plants are extremely sensitive to changes in temperature.

words.zh: n. （热带）丛林；危险地带；丛林音乐；密林；复杂的事物；弱肉强食的地方
words.example: The jungle is full of diverse animals and plants.

words.zh: n. 烟雾；【化】烟雾
words.example: Heavy smog often covers the city in winter.

words.zh: v. 起源；发源；创立；开始；开创
words.example: Most of the air pollutants originate from factories and vehicles.

words.zh: n. 音量；数量；容量；体积；册，卷；【化】体积；【物】体积；【数】体积
words.example: The volume of plastic waste in the ocean keeps increasing.

words.zh: n. 垃圾；垃圾桶；废物；废话，无聊话；无聊作品；废料；食物残渣；【计】垃圾
words.example: Please sort the garbage before throwing it into the bins.

words.zh: n. 企业（或事业）单位，公司；事业；事业心；艰巨复杂的计划
words.example: The new enterprise focuses on developing renewable energy.

words.zh: vt. 恢复；使复原；修补，修复；  v. 归还
words.example: Volunteers worked together to restore the damaged forest.

words.zh: n. 保护；保存；维持，保持
words.example: Wildlife conservation requires the active cooperation of everyone.

words.zh: n. 【数】十二个；  adj. 一打的；十二个的；  num. 一打，十二个；许多
words.example: A dozen students joined the beach cleanup on Saturday.

words.zh: phr. 许多；很多
words.example: Dozens of volunteers came to plant trees near the river.

words.zh: n. 规章，法规，条例；管理；章程；调整，调节；【财】规则，法规；【法】条例；【化】调控
words.example: The new regulation bans the use of harmful chemicals.

words.zh: n. 销毁，丢掉，处理；去掉；清除；【财】处置；【化】处理，处置；  adj. 处理（或置放）废品的
words.example: Proper disposal of electronic waste is very important.

words.zh: n. 检查，细看；查看；视察；【护】视诊；【航】检查
words.example: An inspection of the factory revealed serious pollution problems.

words.zh: vt. 罚款；  n. 罚款；【财】罚款；罚款，罚金；  adj. 可接受的，蛮不错的，美好的；好的；健康的；优质的；晴朗的；精致的；  adv. 可接受，够好；够好，蛮不错
words.example: The company was fined heavily for dumping waste into the river.

words.zh: n. （社会性、政治性）活动，运动；战役；  v. 从事活动；参加运动；领导运动
words.example: The environmental group launched a campaign to protect the local river.

words.zh: n. 水路；航道；水道；舷侧排水沟
words.example: The polluted waterway has become a serious threat to nearby wildlife.

words.zh: vt. 忍受，容忍；容许，允许；包容；能经受住（困难条件）；  v. 【财】容忍
words.example: We cannot tolerate any behavior that harms the natural environment.

words.zh: n. 议程，议程表；议事日程；（潜在的）动机（此时常与hidden连用）
words.example: Protecting endangered species is at the top of our meeting agenda.
